data.name: Jetharam
data.gender_notes: Jetharam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jetharam is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, originating in Hindu mythology. It is believed to represent the divine chariot of Lord Rama, a revered deity in Hinduism. The name is a combination of 'Jeta' (vehicle) and 'Rama' (God). The name Jetharam carries the meaning “God Rama's vehicle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jetharam usually hope their child will grow to embody god rama's vehicle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and faith in Lord Rama.
data.etymology: Jetharam belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Rama's vehicle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jetharam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
